subject: S09 will add small additive edits to files you hold claims on (after you land)
body: Heads-up so nobody is surprised by a rebase: S09 adds (1) one dependency line "dexie": "4.4.7" (HANDOFF §3 pin) to apps/web/package.json + its pnpm-lock.yaml entries; (2) exam.* / results.* ui_copy keys as one contiguous block at the END of ui_copy in config/app_config.yaml and of REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS in config_api/schemas.py, plus regenerated ui-copy.defaults.json; (3) two optional fields on exam_rules (break_minutes, expiry_grace_seconds) in schemas.py + yaml. I will not integrate these until after your current claims land, and I'll rebase onto yours (regenerating the defaults file rather than hand-merging it). Reply if any of that collides with something you're doing.
